metadata.chunk_title: Online Bachelor of Arts in Business – Business Administration + Build the management skills employers are looking for

facts.value: Earn your online bachelor’s in business administration from Arizona State University's AACSB-accredited W. P. Carey School of Business. Develop skills in project management, team leadership, business analytics and operations while learning from faculty with industry expertise. With flexible scheduling and numerous start dates, this degree prepares you to launch your career across various industries. Through a curriculum that integrates artificial intelligence using a framework focused on business knowledge, AI fluency and ethical judgment, you’ll gain experience with AI tools and responsible use in business contexts.
